topic: Disintegration of USSR and Shock Therapy
questionText: The painful economic transition model prescribed by the World Bank and IMF for post-communist Russia and Eastern European states in the 1990s was known as:

options.text: Marshall Plan
Perestroika Accord
Warsaw Transformation
Shock Therapy (sudden transition to privatized neoliberal capitalism)

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:

Hence, Option (D) is the correct answer.

topic: UN Security Council Composition and Veto Power
questionText: The United Nations Security Council (UNSC) comprises five permanent members (P5) endowed with veto power. These five countries are:

options.text: United States, United Kingdom, France, Russia, and China
United States, Germany, Japan, India, and France
United Kingdom, Russia, China, Brazil, and South Africa
United States, Canada, Australia, France, and Russia

detailedSolution:

topic: Kyoto Protocol and Common but Differentiated Responsibilities
questionText: The principle of 'Common but Differentiated Responsibilities' (CBDR) enshrined in the Rio Declaration (1992) and Kyoto Protocol (1997) asserts that:

options.text: Developing countries must reduce carbon emissions at twice the rate of industrialized economies
Every sovereign country must contribute an identical absolute financial sum to green climate funds
All states share responsibility for global environmental protection, but developed nations bear greater historical responsibility to reduce emissions
Global environmental agreements are binding only on non-industrialized island nations

detailedSolution:

Hence, Option (C) is the correct answer.

topic: Internal Emergency 1975
questionText: The National Emergency under Article 352 of the Indian Constitution was proclaimed by President Fakhruddin Ali Ahmed on 25 June 1975 on the grounds of:

options.text: 'Internal disturbance' (later amended to 'armed rebellion' by the 44th Constitutional Amendment)
External war with a neighbouring superpower
Financial bankruptcy of the Reserve Bank of India
Complete failure of the annual southwest monsoon rains

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT Class 12 Pol Science (The Crisis of Democratic Order - Internal Emergency 1975):
The 1975 emergency was declared under Article 352 on the ground of 'internal disturbance'. In 1978, the Janata Party government enacted the 44th Constitutional Amendment, substituting 'armed rebellion' for 'internal disturbance' to prevent executive abuse.

Hence, Option (A) is the correct answer.

topic: Mandal Commission Recommendations
questionText: The Mandal Commission (Second Backward Classes Commission), chaired by B.P. Mandal, submitted its landmark report in 1980 recommending:

10% reservation based solely on individual economic poverty irrespective of caste

The 1975 emergency was declared under Article 352 on the ground of 'internal disturbance'. In 1978, the Janata Party government enacted the 44th Constitutional Amendment, substituting 'armed rebellion' for 'internal disturbance' to prevent executive abuse.

Hence, Option (C) is the correct answer.

topic: Mandal Commission Recommendations
questionText: The Mandal Commission (Second Backward Classes Commission), chaired by B.P. Mandal, submitted its landmark report in 1980 recommending:

options.text: Abolition of all reservations in parliamentary constituencies
50% reservation exclusively for landless rural agricultural labourers
10% reservation based solely on individual economic poverty irrespective of caste
27% reservation in government jobs and educational institutions for Other Backward Classes (OBCs)

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT Class 12 Pol Science (Recent Developments in Indian Politics - Mandal Commission Recommendations):
Appointed in 1979 under Article 340, the Mandal Commission identified 3,743 castes as socially and educationally backward and recommended 27% job reservations for OBCs in public sector and government jobs, implemented by the V.P. Singh government in 1990.

Hence, Option (D) is the correct answer.
